name: Tapioca

low.description: About 2/3 cup cooked tapioca pearls or 1/2 cup flour

siboNotes: Tapioca is well-tolerated on SIBO diets as it's a pure starch without FODMAPs. Easy to digest and gentle on sensitive stomachs.
preparationTips: Soak tapioca pearls for 30 minutes before cooking for even texture
Cook small pearl tapioca for 15-20 minutes until translucent
Use tapioca flour as a thickener for sauces and gravies
Store in airtight container to prevent clumping
nutritionalHighlights: Pure carbohydrate source for quick energy
Contains small amounts of calcium and iron
